title: CertPool missing IntoIterator for owned CertPool
description:
In pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs, CertPool implements IntoIterator for &CertPool (line 133) and Extend (line 127) but does not implement IntoIterator for the owned CertPool. This means callers cannot write 'for cert in pool { ... }' to consume the pool; they must borrow.

What goes wrong: Callers wanting to take ownership of the certificates out of a pool (e.g., to feed them into a Vec<Certificate> without cloning) have no way to do so through the public API. They must call .iter() and clone each certificate.

Location: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs

Recommendation: Add 'impl IntoIterator for CertPool' that consumes self and yields owned Certificate values via Vec::into_iter.
